---
title: "Group lasso parameter selection"
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Group lasso parameter selection}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

Set alpha=0 for group shrinkage. Default weights are the square root of the
number of penalized full parameter-table entries per group; equality mappings
can reduce the independent optimization dimension. selected_groups() marks a
group selected when any relevant coordinate exceeds the zero threshold.
Group sparsity is not a significance test. The Core synthetic workflow is in
basic-cfa.Rmd.
